title: Launch Retrospective
summary: The team reviewed early launch feedback and identified confusion around locating saved notes as a potential onboarding issue. The team agreed to investigate the feedback and explore improvements to the post-recording experience.

keyQuote.text: If people have to figure out where their notes went, we're making them work too hard.
keyQuote.speaker: Michael

highlights.title: A recurring question about saved notes
highlights.text: Michael notices the same question appearing more than once: users are unsure where to find their saved notes after recording.

highlights.title: Make the next step clearer
highlights.text: The confirmation screen says the recording is saved, but does not show what to do next. A clearer screen and a direct link are directions to explore.

highlights.title: Gather evidence and review options
highlights.text: The team will gather and group feedback, explore options, and review them at the next product sync. Priority and release timing remain undecided.

actions.title: Compile and categorize user feedback
actions.text: Group comments by the point where users get confused.

actions.title: Explore a clearer post-recording screen
actions.text: Make the next step after saving more obvious.

actions.title: Assess a direct link to the saved note
actions.text: Check the engineering work required for a direct link.

actions.title: Review feedback and proposals at the next sync
actions.shortTitle: Bring it back to the team.
actions.text: Review the feedback and proposals with the team at the next product sync.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Thanks, everyone. The launch is behind us, and we've had some good early feedback. Let's talk about what worked and what we should improve before the next release.

transcript.speaker: Jordan
transcript.text: The new onboarding flow looks much cleaner. We also saw fewer people dropping off during the first screen.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: Agreed. The app is stable so far. We did get a few reports about slow uploads, but nothing that looks like a major outage.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: I've been looking through the user feedback, and I noticed something interesting. Several people didn't understand what happened to their notes after recording. They weren't sure where to find them later.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Is that really a product issue? Maybe those users just haven't spent enough time exploring the app.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Maybe, but I've seen the same question come up more than once. If people have to figure out where their notes went, we're making them work too hard.

transcript.speaker: Jordan
transcript.text: That's fair. The current confirmation screen tells users their recording is saved, but it doesn't really show them where to go next.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: We could add a direct link to the saved note. That shouldn't be a big change on the engineering side.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds reasonable. Michael, can you share a few examples of the feedback? I'd like us to understand how often this happens before we prioritize it.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Absolutely. I'll pull together the comments and group them by the point where users get confused. That should help us see whether it's a recurring issue.

transcript.speaker: Jordan
transcript.text: I'll explore a clearer post-recording screen and make the next step more obvious.

transcript.speaker: Sam
transcript.text: I'll check what it would take to add a direct link to the saved note.

transcript.speaker: Alex
transcript.text: Great. Let's review the feedback and proposed changes at our next product sync.

transcript.speaker: Michael
transcript.text: Sounds good. I think making the next step clearer could help users feel more confident that their notes are actually there.

scopeNote: This meeting agreed on investigation and exploration. No release date, priority or measured result was committed.
timeNote: Times follow the example’s demo schedule.
